info.title: Smart Campus API
info.description:
API for the Smart Campus Management & Student Services Platform.

**How to test here:**
1. Open **Auth → POST /auth/login**, click **Try it out**, then **Execute** (demo body is filled in).
2. Copy the `token` from the response.
3. Click **Authorize** (top right), paste the token, click **Authorize**.
4. Now every other endpoint's **Try it out** sends your token automatically.

Demo accounts (password `password123`): `admin@campus.com`, `hod@campus.com`, `faculty@campus.com`, `aarav@campus.com`.

Errors always look like `{ "message": "..." }`. 401 = no/bad token, 403 = your role isn't allowed.

Unauthorized.description: No token, or token is invalid / expired

Forbidden.description: Logged in, but this role is not allowed

example.message: Something went wrong on the server

post.summary: Log in and get a JWT token
post.description:
Log in with email + password. Returns a JWT token (valid 1 hour) to send with every other request.

**Who can call it:** public

post.summary: Add a user (student, faculty, HOD, admin)
post.description:
Add a student, faculty, HOD or admin. The password is saved as a salted HMAC-SHA-256 hash.

**Who can call it:** admin
